title: Reconcile research and both reviews into one engine specification and issue register

assigned_to.note: Receives all twenty-five briefs' cards, Reviewer A's register and Reviewer B's register together, after both reviews are complete and frozen. The ten baseline-audit cards for the deployed factors sit alongside the fifteen session cards: the deployed sign, weight, threshold and lookback have to be justified by the same evidence standard, and the overlaps between the two halves are where a specification usually goes wrong.

required_sections: the exact target: cutoff, endpoint, instrument, quote source, flat handling, eligibility and abstention

the complete factor set with each factor's card id and its single role (direction, regime, quality gate, abstention gate), covering all twenty-five entries and stating for each whether it survives, is folded into another factor, or is dropped
how factors combine into one call, stated as an exact computable rule, not a narrative
how conflicts are resolved when factors disagree, including whether any factor can veto another

which information is counted exactly once, with an explicit list of resolved double counts and how each was resolved, including the overlaps inside the deployed set (F2 with F3, F3 with F4, F4 with F6, F1 with F9 and F10, F7 with F8) and between the deployed set and the session set
the abstention rule: the conditions under which no call is published, and the data-quality states that trigger it
what the engine does with missing, stale or revised inputs, factor by factor
the labelled boundary between the repaired version of the current logic and the research-proposed logic, so the two can be scored separately
every rule linked to the card that justifies it and to the specification clause it implements

issue_register.document: issue id, severity, status (accepted, rejected, deferred, unresolved), the reviewer who raised it, and the resolution or the reason it stays open
issue_register.rule: Unresolved disagreements are preserved, not averaged away; a deferred blocker is a stated blocker, not a resolved issue

engine_deliverable.form: one shared numerical implementation usable for both historical scoring and prospective shadow use; historical runs must require no LLM calls
engine_deliverable.trace: an auditable calculation trace per session: input values with their observation instants, each factor's verdict, the combination arithmetic, and the final direction or abstention

hard_rules: Reproduce existing behaviour where it can be reproduced, and document any LLM discretion that cannot be translated faithfully instead of inventing a replacement rule.
The specification must be more than the concatenated research reports; if it cannot be expressed as a computable rule, say so and mark the factor unresolved.
Do not carry any USD-specific sign, weight or threshold to another asset.
Do not present model agreement as evidence of predictive value.
No probability may be published unless a calibration beats the base rate.
No production, workflow, dashboard, dispatcher or configuration change is authorised by the synthesis.
